### Summary

We are using ansible to create and modify VM's on vmware using vsphereautomationSDK , from last friday we are facing issue with tag_manager and it is faiing with ssl errors.

we have recently upgraded vcenters from 6.5 to 7 after that we are facing this issue. we are also using validate_certs:no in the code as well.








urllib3                            1.26.1
vapi-client-bindings               3.1.0
vapi-common-client                 2.12.0
vapi-runtime                       2.12.0
vmc-client-bindings                1.13.0
vmc-draas-client-bindings          1.0.0
vSphere-Automation-SDK             1.7.0





### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

vmware_tag_manager

### Ansible Version

```console
$ ansible --version

```


### Configuration

```console
# if using a version older than ansible-core 2.12 you should omit the '-t all'
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed -t all

no output
```


### OS / Environment

centos7

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```yaml (paste below)

```
---
  - name: Checking or setting the vm tags
    vmware_tag_manager:
      hostname: "{{ vcenter_hostname }}"
      username: "{{ vcenter_username }}"
      password: "{{ vcenter_password }}"
      validate_certs: no
      tag_names:  "{{ item }}"
      object_name: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
      object_type: VirtualMachine
      state: present
    with_items:
      - "{{ tags }}"
      #- "{{ location_fn }}"
      #- "{{ managed }}"
      #- "{{ application_names }}"
    delegate_to: localhost
    register: createtag

we are excepted run the code with out errors
